name: czl-stock-research
description: Stock research and valuation workbench: company mapping, three-method valuation with explicit assumptions, earnings reading, report assembly, position planning, portfolio checks, event scenarios, sector scans, thesis logging and investment committee memos — every verdict carries a target range, a confidence level and a written condition that would prove it wrong.

profession.zh: 股票研究与定价分析师

displayDescription.en: From company teardown to three-method valuation, producing a reviewable rating, target range and position plan, with every judgement written down and traceable.
displayDescription.zh: 从公司拆解到三法定价，产出可复核的评级、目标价区间与仓位方案，并留下可追溯的判断记录。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我给这家公司做估值，给出评级、目标价区间和支撑理由
defaultInitPrompt.en: Value this company for me: give a rating, a target range and the reasoning behind it

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我给这家公司做估值，给出评级、目标价区间和支撑理由
quickPrompts.en: Value this company for me: give a rating, a target range and the reasoning behind it

quickPrompts.zh: 这家公司刚发财报，帮我判断这次业绩到底改变了什么
quickPrompts.en: This company just reported: tell me what actually changed in the numbers

quickPrompts.zh: 我准备建仓，帮我算清楚该买多少、什么情况下该认错
quickPrompts.en: I'm about to open a position: size it for me and define when I should admit I'm wrong
